description: Provisioning from zero, WSL confinement, systemd services and the kill switch end to end (PLAN.md items 16-21). This FEAT changes the real machine (allowed: WSL is dedicated to ossbot): installs %USERPROFILE%\.wslconfig from config/wsl/wslconfig (DESIGN §7.7, backup to .ossbot-local\), wsl.conf + single drvfs fstab line (§7.2), runs the full provision.sh (§18.2: Docker Engine pinned + daemon.json, Docker filter, app deploy to /opt/ossbot/app, images full/llm/proxy, ossbot-egress network, firewall units fail-closed, all §7.5 units except runner/Hermes, anchors chattr +a, secrets seed per PLAN Decision 5, start with dry-run ON), registers ossbot-autostart, implements boot gate / ossbot-kill / ossbot-resume / kill.ps1 / resume.ps1 / watchdog (§13), setup-secrets (validated, not run with real values), the local gitignored config/profile.yaml (PLAN Decision 6), ossctl CLI skeleton + doctor that lists items awaiting secrets, and the sandbox smoke + system test suites (§22.5, §22.6, §22.8). Hermes and kiro-cli-for-hermes provision steps are named no-ops until FEAT-007 (Decision 8). Depends on FEAT-001..003.
steps: Item 16: verify DESIGN §23 items 1, 3, 4, 25 (web + live) and write ADR-0013/ADR-0007 addenda. Write config/wsl/wslconfig (§7.7 verbatim), scripts/lib/{common.ps1,wslconfig.ps1}, scripts/lib/wsl.sh (wsl.conf §7.2 with default=ossnobody, automount off, mountFsTab, interop off; managed '# BEGIN ossbot' fstab block with the \134 form, fallbacks D:/Work/... then D:\\Work\\..., rollback from /etc/fstab.ossbot.bak), scripts/bootstrap.ps1 (§18.2 steps 1-6; -Only <phase> switch; from-zero create via wsl --install Ubuntu-24.04 --name ossbot --location <repo>\.wsl\ossbot --no-launch; --import-in-place offer; never unregister; Hyper-V step only when already elevated else WARN; -DistroName/-Location for tests/system/test_bootstrap_zero.ps1 which refuses 'ossbot'), scripts/hyperv-firewall.ps1 (+ -Remove), scripts/uninstall-host.ps1, scripts/test-isolation.ps1 (§22.8; PE check uses a copy of C:\Windows\System32\whoami.exe in .ossbot-local\isolation\). Run bootstrap -Only wsl and test-isolation.

Item 17: complete provision.sh steps docker, dockerfilter, app deploy, kiro-cli-for-hermes (no-op), hermes (no-op), images (write digests to config/versions.lock.yaml), networks, firewall, systemd (+ systemd/tmpfiles.d/ossbot.conf; units of §7.5 with hardening, Requires/After firewall units, ExecStartPre=+/opt/ossbot/bin/ossbot-firewall --check, ExecCondition boot-gate --allow minimal for gatekeeper/proxy), audit anchors, secrets seed (Decision 5), enable/start, doctor --quick; scripts/lib/{docker.sh,firewall.sh,images.sh,services.sh,kiro.sh}; systemd/*. Re-record the Docker filter allow corpus from the pinned docker CLI (§23 item 15) and re-run the filter tests. Run the full bootstrap twice.

Item 18: scripts/bin/{ossbot-boot-gate,ossbot-kill,ossbot-resume} (self-contained bash per §13.2-13.3, resume.log append N4), ossbot-enforce-kill/resume units and path units, scripts/{kill.ps1,resume.ps1} (marker first, 30 s timeout -> wsl --terminate, -Hard disables task + wsl --shutdown), src/ossbot/watchdog/{tick.py,anchors.py,perms.py} + ossbot-watchdog.timer, anchor socket service, src/ossbot/ctl/cli.py (status, pause, kill, resume incl. offline path, dryrun, config reload, audit verify, doctor, test), scripts/ossctl.ps1, tests/system/test_kill.ps1 with all §22.6 kill cases.

Item 19: scripts/setup-secrets.ps1 + scripts/setup-secrets.sh (§18.3; NUL record over stdin; validation regexes; preserves seeded randoms; --selftest against a temp root). Create the local gitignored config/profile.yaml with the owner values of PLAN Decision 6 (never commit it). src/ossbot/ctl/doctor.py with every §18.3 check in M11 order; checks needing Telegram/GitHub/Kiro secrets report AWAITING SECRET; Windows part in ossctl.ps1 doctor.

Item 20: tests/sandbox/test_profiles.py (§22.5 via sandboxd and the probe entrypoint; key-dependent cases marked needs_key and skipped with a reason) and tests/system/{test_control_perms,test_secret_perms,test_docker_filter,test_egress_per_uid,test_firewall_failclosed,test_proxy_dns,test_config_write,test_audit_anchor}.sh; fix whatever they find in FEAT-001..003 code.

Item 21: run the complete '### Phase 1 verification' block of docs/PLAN.md, run gitleaks over the history, set status completed, record findings (verified WSL/Docker facts, doctor output summary, anything Phase 2 needs), commit locally.
acceptance_criteria: scripts\bootstrap.ps1 succeeds and a second run prints only 'unchanged' (AC 1 for Phase 1 steps); docker version and docker compose version work as root; ossbot-gatekeeper, ossbot-dockerfilter, ossbot-proxy, ossbot-sandboxd, ossbot-firewall, ossbot-firewall-docker, ossbot-boot-gate and ossbot-watchdog.timer are active; ossbot-firewall --check exits 0

After wsl --terminate ossbot, scripts\test-isolation.ps1 passes every AC 2 / §22.8 check (no /mnt/c, only the repo under /mnt/d, PE exec fails with Exec format error, default user ossnobody, nproc 20, ~20 GB RAM, ~8 GB swap, localhost forwarding probe fails)

tests\system\test_kill.ps1 passes AC 9 (containers gone <= 10 s, gatekeeper 423, soft/full reboot cases, distro-stopped marker, hung kill returns ~35 s, resume order) and -Hard leaves WSL stopped with resume.ps1 restoring
ROOTDEV pytest -m sandbox passes (key-free AC 12 checks) and every tests/system/*.sh exits 0 (AC 18)
ossctl doctor (distro and Windows parts) completes; only secret-dependent checks are AWAITING SECRET, Hyper-V may be WARN when not elevated, everything else PASS
config/profile.yaml exists locally and is not tracked; git status --porcelain empty after the commit

wsl.exe -d ossbot -u root --cd /mnt/d/Work/autonomous-oss-contributor --exec /usr/bin/env UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/root/.venvs/ossbot /opt/ossbot/bin/uv run --frozen pytest -m sandbox
wsl.exe -d ossbot -u root --cd /mnt/d/Work/autonomous-oss-contributor --exec bash tests/system/test_control_perms.sh   # and each other tests/system/*.sh
wsl.exe -d ossbot -u root --exec systemctl is-active ossbot-gatekeeper ossbot-dockerfilter ossbot-proxy ossbot-sandboxd ossbot-watchdog.timer
wsl.exe -d ossbot -u root --exec docker version ; wsl.exe -d ossbot -u root --exec docker compose version
wsl.exe -d ossbot -u root --exec /opt/ossbot/app/.venv/bin/ossctl doctor ; powershell -NoProfile -File scripts\ossctl.ps1 doctor

findings: VERIFIED 2026-10-18 on this laptop (ADR-0013/0007/0005/0001 addenda). WSL 3.0.3.0 / kernel 6.18.54.1: .wslconfig honoured after wsl --shutdown (nproc 20, MemTotal 19.5 GiB, swap 8 GiB); autoMemoryReclaim/sparseVhd still [experimental]; instanceIdleTimeout=-1 keeps the distro and systemd units up after wsl.exe exits (autostart task action stays /bin/true, run via conhost.exe --headless, Task Scheduler stores the 60 s delay as PT1M); localhostForwarding=false blocks Windows->distro 127.0.0.1; wsl --manage ossbot --set-sparse true worked (once, .ossbot-local/sparse.state); wsl --help lists --install --name --location --no-launch, --install --no-distribution, --import-in-place (from-zero path implemented, not run live: test_bootstrap_zero.ps1 is manual, test distro names only). fstab form D:\134Work\134autonomous-oss-contributor works (9p aname=drvfs, metadata,uid=1000,gid=1500,umask=002), survives shutdown; Windows-created files show ossadmin:osscfg 775. DEVIATION: [interop] enabled=false does not unregister the WSLInterop binfmt entry on 3.0.3 (PE files did not get ENOEXEC) -> wsl.sh installs ossbot-nointerop.service (sysinit, writes -1 to WSLInterop*); wsl.sh check + doctor fail if it reappears. Leftover ext4 /mnt/c removed via a bind mount of / after the restart. default=ossnobody honoured. DOCKER: 29.9.1 (API 1.56), containerd 2.4.2, buildx 0.38.0, compose v5.6.0 from download.docker.com (key fpr 9DC858229FC7DD38854AE2D88D81803C0EBFCD88 now in versions.lock), apt-mark hold; FirewallBackend iptables; containerd image store (ossbot/@sha256: works with --pull never); dockerd resets its data root to 0710 on each start, so users.sh now expects root:root 0710 for /srv/ossbot/docker (deviation from 0700, still root-only). docker.service drop-in Requires/After ossbot-boot-gate, After ossbot-firewall. Image digests (versions.lock + /etc/ossbot/versions.lock.yaml) recorded by the images step (tag ossbot/:in-, superseded tags removed; .dockerignore limits the context). sandbox-full build ~10 min. CORPUS (§23 item 15): re-recorded from the pinned CLI (tests/unit/dockerfilter/record_corpus.py -> corpus/recorded.json, run as ROOTDEV python -m tests.unit.dockerfilter.record_corpus after any argv change); cli_model fixed (MemorySwappiness -1, Dns null, ReadOnly omitted when false, no OnBuild, EndpointsConfig {}); filter now accepts MemorySwappiness null|-1 and GET /networks/ (docker network rm inspects first); test_recorded_corpus.py asserts model == real CLI and filter allows every recorded request. FIXES IN EARLIER FEAT CODE: HOME tmpfs needs mode=1777 (Docker mounts tmpfs root:root 0700); --workdir /home/agent/cwd is created root:root 0755 (cd ok, not writable) - Phase 2 must confirm kiro-cli writes nothing to cwd; gatekeeper models.yaml replace now keeps the file mode/group (it had become gatekeeper:gatekeeper 0640, unreadable to the runner/ossadmin); KIRO_KEY_SHA256 is a comma list (policy.kiro_key_hashes); control dir is gatekeeper:osscontrol 2750 (setgid so flags stay group osscontrol); /run/ossbot is root:root 1755 + ACL rwx for gatekeeper and ossbox (stat shows 1775); gatekeeper/sandboxd units add SupplementaryGroups=ossapi/osssbx to chown their sockets. probe.sh gained smoke/hostile/execd modes. kiro-cli settings list (no key) honours $HOME/.kiro/settings/cli.json on a tmpfs HOME: all 8 keys as baked. POWERSHELL: Process.StandardInput writes a UTF-8 BOM at Process.Start when the console input code page is 65001 -> scripts/lib/common.ps1 Set-OssStdinEncoding + Invoke-OssStdin (raw bytes) used by every stream (bootstrap, resume, kill, setup-secrets); args containing double quotes are passed base64 through a streamed line (PS 5.1 does not escape embedded quotes). Use Invoke-OssWsl/Invoke-OssStream* from Phase 2 scripts. DOCTOR: distro part summary PASS 23, AWAITING SECRET 7 (sandbox Kiro auth+catalog, safety probes, hermes Kiro key, GitHub write, GitHub read, Telegram bot token, profile.telegram.user_id), SKIP 3 (Hermes checks, FEAT-007), exit 0; Windows part PASS .wslconfig hash, localhost forwarding, autostart task, kill marker; WARN Hyper-V firewall (not elevated: inbound Block already, outbound Allow, 0/2 rules; run elevated scripts\hyperv-firewall.ps1 later). PHASE 1 VERIFICATION (all pass): lint gate (ruff, format, mypy 100 files, lint-imports 4 contracts, shellcheck all scripts); DEV pytest -m 'unit or telegram' 1494 passed; ROOTDEV pytest -m sandbox 8 passed, 2 skipped needs_key (Kiro host CONNECT, S-ws-1); all 8 tests/system/*.sh pass; tests/system/test_kill.ps1 64 checks (containers gone 0.7 s, gatekeeper 423, soft/full reboot, distro-stopped marker, hung kill 36 s via wsl --terminate, resume order gatekeeper only unchanged; docker/compose version; units active; ossbot-firewall --check 0; ossctl audit verify ok (anchors checked); setup-secrets --selftest; gitleaks git clean (root needs safe.directory: /root/.gitconfig managed block in users step; .gitleaksignore lists the FEAT-003 fake Kiro key fixture fingerprint). FOR PHASE 2: runner/hermes units must copy the gatekeeper/sandboxd unit pattern (Requires both firewall units, ExecStartPre=+ossbot-firewall --check, ConditionPathExists=!killed) and be added to OSSBOT_ENABLE_UNITS + enable-start in scripts/lib/services.sh, to ossbot-kill stop list (already listed) and tests/system/lib.sh PHASE1_UNITS; test_firewall_failclosed uses sandboxd until ossbot-runner exists; ossctl has status/pause/kill/resume (offline path)/dryrun/config reload/audit verify/doctor/test (no model/policy/backup/egress subcommands yet); doctor --probes only reports AWAITING SECRET; sandbox smoke harness tests/sandbox/conftest.py drives JobService.execute directly (useful for e2e_docker); the 'catalog' smoke runs, agent-llm is covered through the coder pair; WSL distros share one network namespace, so test_bootstrap_zero.ps1 affects ossbot's iptables/Docker.
